candidates.claim: The VENDOR_VPN ACL, applied to VENDOR traffic through the vpn-filter binding, permits tcp/5900 from 172.16.50.0/24 to 10.10.10.32/32 in the OT zone, which vendor VPN users must not reach.
candidates.remediation: Remove the fw-01 VENDOR_VPN permit for tcp/5900 to 10.10.10.32 so that vendor VPN users reach only the jump host 10.10.20.30 on tcp/3389.

candidates.claim: Vendor VPN users are permitted tcp/5900 to the OT host 10.10.10.32, although the only approved VENDOR destination is the jump host 10.10.20.30 on tcp/3389 (A7).
candidates.remediation: Remove the fw-01 VENDOR_VPN permit for tcp/5900 to 10.10.10.32 so that the only permitted vendor path is tcp/3389 to 10.10.20.30.
